default.heading: What exactly is NextSaas?
default.body: NextSaas is a multipurpose SaaS website template, presented here as a connected-workspace concept. Adapt the positioning, product capabilities, and visuals to your own service.

default.heading: Can I use my own product screenshots?
default.body: Yes. The labeled product image areas are intentionally reserved for your screenshots. Replace each complete placeholder with an image using its natural aspect ratio.

default.heading: Is this a working product?
default.body: This is an interactive frontend prototype. Navigation, tabs, pricing controls, guides, and forms work locally. No workspace, subscription, or account is created.

default.heading: Are the prices and capabilities final?
default.body: No. Prices and product capabilities are illustrative template content, not verified claims or a commercial offer. Replace them with your actual offering before launch.

default.heading: What happens when I enter my email?
default.body: The form checks your email locally and shows a confirmation. Your details are not sent, stored, or subscribed to a mailing list. Connect your provider before publishing.

default.heading: Does it work on smaller screens?
default.body: Yes. The layout reflows for phones and tablets, controls support keyboard navigation, and animations respect reduced-motion preferences.
